verdicts.reason: مُنْطَادًا is the standard vocalisation; the proposed مِنْطَادًا would make it worse. مُنْطَاد (munṭād) is the active participle of form VII اِنْطَادَ 'to rise high into the air' (root ط و د, like مُنْقَاد from اِنْقَادَ), coined in this sense in the 19th century (attributed to Aḥmad Fāris al-Shidyāq); classical lexica already have بِنَاءٌ مُنْطَادٌ 'a lofty building'. Wiktionary gives مُنْطَاد /mun.tˤaːd/, pl. مَنَاطِيد, and Langenscheidt's Arabic-German dictionary gives [munˈtɒːd]; Hans Wehr lists it under طود as munṭād (the reviewer's 'Hans Wehr: minṭād' is a misattribution). مِنْطَاد is a popular analogy with the mifʿāl instrument pattern (encouraged by the plural مَنَاطِيد) and is heard, but it is not the dictionary form. Keep مُنْطَادًا (munṭādan); no change to segs, glossary or readings.
